rationale: Block B0128 is a genuine revision: it expressly limits both traces to synthetic, manuscript-local conformance examples and disclaims surface records, validator runs, scientific input or result, and census outcomes. Its valid trace supplies BP and CP producer-private payload tags, adapter mapping into named common fields, recognized predicate dispatch, checker-only state movement from declared through parsed and predicate_checked to accepted, and a closed terminal interpretation. Its invalid trace supplies substantive fail-closed BP and CP outcomes: missing inverse_class_digest produces rejected:missing_inverse_link, while unknown_demo produces not_evaluable:unrecognized_proof_type. The invalid trace nevertheless starts at BP-shaped and CP-shaped records; it does not show the producer-private invalid payload for either branch, the adapter-to-common mapping from each such payload, or the adapter predicate applied in each invalid branch. The concluding statement that the examples expose end-to-end semantics does not itself provide those missing case-level elements. Because the should_fix revision satisfies a substantial subset but not every conjunct of the exact Phase-1 fully-addressed pattern, PARTIALLY_ADDRESSED applies; the evidence is directly inspectable and does not show degradation relative to the original B0062.

evidence_anchors.supports: The controlling pattern requires non-scientific valid and invalid BP/CP cases, each showing producer-private payload, common semantic mapping, adapter predicate, validator state transition, and fail-closed result, without census-outcome framing.
The original block listed desired accepted and rejected fixtures but stated that no fixture bytes or runs existed; it contained no BP/CP end-to-end trace.

The inserted block contains the synthetic/non-census disclaimer, the detailed valid BP/CP trace, and the two terminal invalid outcomes; it also exposes the missing invalid-branch private-payload, mapping, and adapter-predicate detail.
The patch associates the B0128 text exactly with REV-P33-011.
The apply report records the REV-P33-011 insert_after operation on B0062 and the resulting fresh block B0128.
The bundle binds the compared base, patch, apply report, post-round draft, and final draft hashes used for this tie-break.

provenance.criterion_application: exact Phase-1 operationalization; equivalence allowed; no added standard

boundaries.evidence_scope: Only the bound Phase-1 criterion record and the five named revision evidence files were used for the item judgment; the tie-break precommitment and ARS re-review protocol supplied procedure and scope only.
boundaries.authority: This artifact commits only the closed tie-break verdict for REV-P33-011 and grants no manuscript, scientific-result, later-stage, or publication authority.
